What will $1,000 cost in 10 years? 💸

At 2% yearly inflation, the same goods cost about $1,219 in 10 years. Your $1,000 would then buy only about $820 of today's goods.

The inflation calculator shows:
✅ The future cost of the same goods
✅ How much buying power you lose
✅ How many years until money buys half as much

Set your own amount, years and rate.
